title: dashboards: two globalFilters with the same name are accepted; the board draws one control and its value filters the other filter's field
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Filing gate: ① a product defect, found beside the clauses (dashboards.global-filters-rescope), reach: `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard` and the console board, measured twice.
Business reason: two global filters that share a name (easy to do when one is copied) are accepted. The board draws one control, and a value typed into it filters the field of the other definition, so the reader gets a silently wrong number on a tile. The save door already refuses an unknown filter binding (`dashboard-filter-binding-unknown`); a duplicate name is the same class.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then the `domain:server` lane (`packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.ts` or `GlobalFilterSchema` in `packages/spec`). QA suggestion only: `area:dashboards`, p3.
Duplicate search: `duplicate global filter name dashboard` → 79 hits, all QA run records, the sweep anchor, or unrelated.
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/qa_probe_dfn` with `globalFilters:[{"name":"r","field":"region","type":"text"},{"name":"r","field":"status","type":"text"}]` and one metric widget → 200, active, no lint issue.
2. Open `/_console/apps/showcase_app/dashboard/qa_probe_dfn`: one control (`[data-testid=dashboard-filter-r]`, count 1).
3. Type "north" and press Enter: the widget query carries `{"status":{"$contains":"north"}}`, the second definition's field, and the tile reads 0.

Expected: duplicate filter names refused at the save door. Actual: accepted; one control filters the other definition's field. Reproduced 2 times on fresh loads.

QA-source: #29002 · dashboards.global-filters-rescope · observed beside the clauses
